title: Universal Canonicalization Rules
description: Lookup tables for transformations the canonicalize function applies across every axis: named-color resolution, phase aliases, scope shape map, and the value-envelope lifting catalog. Structural rules (parsing $bind:<id> strings, deep-merging extends chains) live in canonicalize code; this file holds the data those rules consult.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor tooling. Optional.

namedColors.description: Author-side color names mapped to canonical RGB tuples. Locked at the level of approval — additions are versionless table edits but must round-trip through corpus tests.

phases.description: Author-side phase aliases. 'all' is the only one that expands to a multi-element array; the rest are pass-through.

single.description: Single-string phase forms accepted by the canonicalizer (string lifts to single-element array).

scopeShapeMap.description: Author-side scope shorthand shapes mapped to canonical ScopeSpec variants. Each entry documents the wire form, not a transformation rule directly — the canonicalizer pattern-matches on author shape and emits the canonical form.

authorShape.description: JSON shape the author writes (illustrative, not strict).

blockedOn.description: If the canonical destination depends on a pending schema gap, name it here. Canonicalizer treats blocked entries as parse errors with a clear message until the gap lands.

nodeFieldLifts.description: Structural lifts that move information OUT of an author-facing position into a sibling NodeSpec field. Example: '{ scope: { channel: "foreground" } }' lifts the channel out of scope and into the NodeSpec.writeChannels array. Documented here so the docs generator and canonicalize function agree on the surface; the structural transformation itself lives in canonicalize code.

canonicalField.description: Canonical NodeSpec field the value lifts to (e.g., 'writeChannels').

valueRule.description: How the author-side value translates to the canonical-side value.

shadowFieldRenames.description: Shadow-block author-side names mapped to canonical ShadowSpec field names + value renames. The shadow block is a non-trivial sub-tree; documenting renames separately keeps the alias tables clean.

envelopes.description: The value-envelope-lifting catalog. Each entry names an author-side scalar shape and the canonical { kind, value } envelope it lifts into. Drives both the canonicalize function's type inference and the docs generator.

durationStringForms.description: Accepted duration string suffixes for canonicalization to milliseconds envelope.

sigils.description: String-form sigils the canonicalizer recognizes in input positions. Documented here so docs and validators agree on the surface.
